MoAI-ADK 2026.11.0-rc.1 — agentic development kit

Usage: moai <command> [options]
       moai cc|codex|glm -l|-a    lead or agent session

Start
  cc, codex, glm        Start a Claude Code, Codex or GLM
                        session
Project
  project-detect        Detect the project's facts
  project-plan          Preview the project profile
  project-apply         Write a previewed project profile
  language-setup        Choose the writing language item by
                        item
  index-build           Build the code map index
Update and move
  update                Update MoAI from the installed
                        package
  go-state-plan         Preview moving the Go-era .moai
                        folder
  go-state-apply        Move a previewed Go-era .moai folder
  go-state-revert-plan  Preview undoing a Go-era folder move
  go-state-revert       Undo a Go-era folder move
  home-state-plan       Preview moving the Go-era ~/.moai
                        folder
  home-state-apply      Move a previewed Go-era ~/.moai
                        folder
  home-state-revert     Undo a ~/.moai folder move
  worktree-move-plan    Preview moving this clone's
                        worktrees
  worktree-move-apply   Move the previewed worktrees
Keys
  key-set               Store a provider key in the vault
  key-status            Check a provider key without showing
                        it
  key-remove            Remove a provider key from the vault
  key-import-plan       Preview importing an old key file
  key-import-apply      Import a previewed old key file
Diagnose
  claude-doctor         Check that Claude Code reads
                        AGENTS.md
  codex-doctor          Check the Codex instructions and
                        skills
  install-inspect       Show the installed MoAI binaries
  identity              Show where a path sits in its clone
  worktree-report       Report the space worktrees use
  optimize-plan         Preview space that can be freed
  baseline-inventory    List a checkout's baseline facts

Run 'moai help --all' for every command.
Run 'moai <command> --help' for details and examples.
